items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: The interviewee discusses business arrangements involving 'Speck' and a place, while the interviewer introduces 'Farah Lewell' in a clarifying question. The interviewee does not mention Lewell or describe any personal or professional relationship with them.

ctx.x: Yeah, he got the place now, you see? He built up new, you know, the remodeling place, built a new building now. Well, he's still going to have the place, you see, but he ain't going to have nothing but concrete allowance in there, you see? So Speck was expecting to manage that place again, but Speck didn't want to do him a partnership. He wanted, you know, just one man, you know what I mean? Because this fellow don't have a good reputation for business, you know? So, in fact, he don't run the place, no harm. He…
So, alright, so Farah Lewell. $150, I didn't understand, $150 a week for how many? For one cocktail lounge or two or what? One.
